report: Legacy Commitments of Traders, Futures Only (deacot yearly archives as listed on the Historical Compressed page captured by the probe)
method: One unauthenticated HTTPS GET per yearly archive, timeout 60 s, maximum_bytes enforced, no retries, no redirect following. The ZIP is stored as received and SHA-256 bound; member names, sizes and member SHA-256 are inventoried; CRC verified. No row is parsed into a research panel by this manifest.
availability_rule: Positions as of Tuesday are released Friday 15:30 America/New_York per the CFTC release schedule. The probe captured the explanatory-notes page (receipt bound above) but the schedule sentence was not machine-extracted; the parse step must bind the actual release date per report from the CFTC release calendar before any row is used. A report is usable at the first canonical XAU D1 decision strictly after the end of its release day in America/New_York plus one full session; never at its as-of date.
